title: Genesis Bond
description: The first Stacks Bitcoin Staking bond. Its protocol eligibility is derived from PoX-5 bond period 1 on every live read.

attestation.scope: Genesis Bond identity, product status, and supported route types

protocolTerms.coverageBoundary: Stacks PoX-5 Bitcoin Staking only; STX-only stacking and non-Stacks yield products are excluded.
protocolTerms.signerAndAdministrationControls: Live PoX-5 state has precedence over owner-maintained product targets and enrollment status.
audits: Use the current registry sources and live protocol state for security diligence.
unresolvedTerms: Current capacity, duration, fees, enrollment window, operators, and deployed integration details must come from the live registry.

participationRoutes.name: Genesis native-L1 direct

attestation.scope: Direct native-L1 Genesis Bond route type

participationRoutes.summary: Direct participation using a Bitcoin L1 timelock, subject to current eligibility, enrollment, and custody requirements.

enrollment.method: Consult the current registry for the approved enrollment flow.

recovery.evidence: Confirm current recovery requirements before participation.

earlyExit.evidence: No current bond-specific early-exit commitment is stored in the bundled fallback.

participationRoutes.name: Genesis sBTC pool route

attestation.scope: Permissionless sBTC pool route type for the Genesis Bond

participationRoutes.summary: Permissionless participation through StackingDAO's planned sBTC pool and stBTC liquid-staking design.

rewardAccounting.method: Consult the current registry for current accounting details.

withdrawalTerms.timing: Not present in the bundled fallback.

attestation.scope: StackingDAO stBTC design and planned Zest Protocol use

redemption.method: Planned withdrawals use an idle buffer, with an asynchronous cooldown path when reserves are insufficient.
redemption.timing: The architecture targets about one reward cycle for cooldown and describes an express path with a fee.

liquidityEvidence.description: The architecture targets a liquid stBTC token and planned Zest collateral use; deployed market liquidity is not yet verified.

oracleEvidence.description: Zest ratio-aware pricing is planned, but the final stBTC oracle and risk configuration remain prerequisites.

notes: Bond period 1 maps to reward Cycle 143 under PoX-5; the cycle and burn height are derived live and are not editable product fields.
An approximate calendar date is derived from remaining burn blocks using Bitcoin's ten-minute target.
